A four-day Kyoto trip with a balanced pace. It opens with a relaxed arrival day at Nijo Castle and Gion. Day 2 has Fushimi Inari first thing, then the Higashiyama temples. Day 3 covers Arashiyama and the northern temples, and the last morning is light, with the Imperial Palace and Nishiki Market. The plan stays well inside your ¥400,000 budget, and the Ace Hotel is central for evenings out.
